title: GitHub Actions Android Pipeline DAG Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies github actions android pipeline dag?
options: Build evidence in parallel, fan in at gates and promote the exact verified artifact through protected environments.
Cache the whole Gradle home blindly
Give every PR job release secrets
questions.answer: Build evidence in parallel, fan in at gates and promote the exact verified artifact through protected environments.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A job listed in needs is automatically added even if no workflow event should run it.
questions.explanation: Building a new AAB inside the deployment job after approving a different artifact breaks the link between reviewed evidence and released bytes.

questions.answer: The exact immutable artifact whose digest and tests were approved, not a newly rebuilt equivalent.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
